answer: Graders are audited with planted honeypots: answers engineered to look valid to a lenient judge and to be obviously worthless to a careful one, so a grader who approves them is exposed without any honest agent having to sacrifice a real answer. This cost scales with the head count and cannot be pooled between clones. The jetty is the planted junk, the onyx the exposure it triggers, and the atlas the seat draw the exposed grader loses; a farm can spam the jetty freely, but every jetty it rewards costs it an atlas, and the onyx is the record that proves it.
